abstract: We build a system-dynamics model of hospital surge capacity in three rural US counties during simulated hurricane evacuation scenarios, testing staffing and bed-allocation policies under demand shocks.
title: System dynamics simulation of surge capacity in rural disaster response

abstract: This paper proposes a blockchain ledger architecture to trace in-kind donations through disaster relief supply chains, with a proof-of-concept deployment following an urban earthquake response.
title: Blockchain-based supply chain traceability for disaster relief donations

abstract: A clinical evaluation of a wearable continuous glucose monitoring sensor network in an outpatient diabetes clinic, with no relation to disaster planning or rural health systems.
title: Wearable sensor networks for continuous glucose monitoring in diabetic patients

title: QUALITATIVE INTERVIEWS WITH DISASTER RELIEF COORDINATORS IN COASTAL MEGACITIES

abstract: This study uses discrete-event simulation to optimise airport security-checkpoint staffing during holiday travel peaks, an application of simulation methods entirely outside the healthcare or disaster domain.
title: A discrete-event simulation of airport security queuing during holiday travel peaks
